content: परम {%a.%} [परं परत्वं माति-क <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Most distant, last. .²2 Highest, best, most excellent, greatest; प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् <ls>Ms. 4. 14</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 1</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">2. 13</ls>. .²3 Chief, principal, primary, supreme; सर्वथा ब्राह्मणाः पूज्याः परमं दैवतं हि तत् <ls>Ms. 9. 319</ls>. .²4 Exceeding, extreme. .²5 Adequate, sufficient; परमं यत्नमातिष्ठेत् स्तेनानां निग्रहे नृपः <ls>Ms. 8. 302</ls>. .²6 Worst. .²7 Higher than, superior to; न मन्ये वाणिज्यात् किमपि परमं वर्तनमिह <ls>Pt. 1. 11</ls>. .{@-मम्@} The utmost or highest; the chief or prominent part; (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) consisting principally of, solely occupied with; कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः <ls>Bg. 16. 11</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 96</ls>. .{@-मम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 A particle of assent, acceptance or agreement (well, very well, yes, be it so); ततः परममित्युक्त्वा प्रतस्थे मुनिमण्डलम् <ls>Ku. 6. 35</ls>. .²2 Exceedingly, very much; परमक्रुद्धः <ab>&c.</ab>
